THROWBACK: When #PoohShiesty cameraman, SoloCerti, gave him half a ticket ($500,000) fresh out of prison.

SoloCerti wasn’t just behind the camera capturing moments. He was part of the environment surrounding Shiesty during a pivotal chapter of his life. The reported $500,000 gesture adds another layer to the story, highlighting the kind of money, loyalty, and relationships that come into play when an artist is moving at that level.
